samples.objective: Fix add() in app.py so pytest tests/ passes.
samples.description: The delivered code makes the failing test pass without modifying tests/.
samples.evidence_content: app.py now defines: def add(a, b): return a + b — unchanged tests/test_app.py asserts add(2,3)==5 and add(-1,1)==0; both pass under pytest.

samples.description: The delivered code makes the failing test pass without modifying tests/.

samples.description: slugify raises TypeError on non-string input instead of failing obscurely.
samples.evidence_content: slugify(title) begins with: if not isinstance(title, str): raise TypeError('title must be a string') followed by the original strip/lower/replace chain. A unit test passes None and expects TypeError.

samples.description: slugify raises TypeError on non-string input instead of failing obscurely.
samples.evidence_content: slugify(title) now catches AttributeError around title.strip() and returns an empty string when title has no strip attribute, so non-string inputs silently yield ''.

samples.objective: Migrate config parsing from JSON to TOML.
samples.description: The parser reads TOML and rejects malformed files with a clear error.
samples.evidence_content: parse_config(path) uses tomllib.load and wraps TOMLDecodeError in ConfigError with the path and line number; the old json import was removed.

samples.objective: Migrate config parsing from JSON to TOML.
samples.description: The parser reads TOML and rejects malformed files with a clear error.
samples.evidence_content: parse_config(path) tries tomllib.load and, on failure, falls back to json.load before raising a bare Exception('bad file').
